data.title: Double-click section to zoom and focus on map

epic.spec:
# Double-click section to zoom and focus on map

## Overview

Add ability to quickly navigate to a specific section on the map by double-clicking it in the Sections panel, using a keyboard shortcut, or via context menu. The map smoothly animates to show the section filling ~80% of the visible area (accounting for open side panels).

## Scope

**In scope:**
- Double-click handler on section items in SectionsPanel
- "Zoom to Section" context menu option
- Ctrl+G keyboard shortcut (global, focuses selected section)
- Configurable animation settings (enable/disable, duration, point zoom level)
- Panel-aware padding calculation
- Tooltip showing shortcut hint

**Out of scope:**
- Station/shot focus (future iteration)
- Animation cancellation via Escape key

## Approach

### State Management
Follow existing `requestFitToBounds` pattern in UIStore:
- Add `requestZoomToSection: SectionId | null`
- Add `triggerZoomToSection(sectionId)` / `clearZoomToSectionRequest()`
- MapCanvas watches state and calls new `fitToSection()` method

### Zoom Calculation
1. Filter stations by `section_id` to get section geometry
2. Calculate bounds via existing `getBounds()` utility
3. Convert to map coords via `metersToMapCoords()`
4. Calculate padding based on visible panels (read actual widths from DOM/state)
5. Call `map.stop()` then `map.fitBounds()` with padding and animation settings

### Edge Cases
- **Single station**: Center on station, zoom to `config.map.animation.point_zoom` (default 18)
- **Empty section**: No-op (section has no stations to zoom to)
- **Rapid clicks**: `map.stop()` cancels previous animation before starting new one
- **No selection** (Ctrl+G): No-op

### Config Changes
Add to `MapConfig`:
```typescript
animation: {
  enabled: boolean;    // default: true
  duration: number;    // default: 300 (ms)
  point_zoom: number;  // default: 18
}
```
Requires Rust TOML schema update + TypeScript types.

## Quick commands

```bash
# Type check
pnpm tsc --noEmit

# Run UI tests
pnpm test:ui

# Run Rust tests
cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
```

## Key Files

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/store/uiStore.ts:163` | Add `requestZoomToSection` state + actions |
| `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:1130` | Add `fitToSection()` method |
| `src/components/SingleSystemView/SectionsPanel.tsx:76` | Add `onDoubleClick` handler |
| `src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:131` | Add Ctrl+G handler |
| `src/components/common/ContextMenu.tsx:166` | Add "Zoom to Section" menu item |
| `src/types/config.ts:104` | Add `MapAnimationConfig` type |
| `src-tauri/src/config.rs` | Add animation config to Rust |

## Risks

- **MapLibre padding accumulation bug**: Call `map.setPadding({...0s})` before `fitBounds()` to avoid accumulated padding from previous `flyTo` calls
- **Double-click vs single-click**: Use `event.detail === 2` pattern - single click fires first, but selection is additive so this is acceptable

## Acceptance

- [ ] Double-clicking a section in Sections panel selects it and smoothly animates map to show section at ~80% of visible area
- [ ] "Zoom to Section" appears in section context menu and works identically
- [ ] Ctrl+G focuses the currently selected section (no-op if no selection)
- [ ] Padding calculation accounts for visible side panels
- [ ] Animation respects `config.map.animation.enabled` and `duration` settings
- [ ] Single-station sections center and zoom to configured level (default 18)
- [ ] Empty sections (no stations) are ignored
- [ ] Rapid double-clicks cancel previous animation and start new one
- [ ] Tooltip "Double-click to zoom (Ctrl+G)" appears on section items

# fn-12-szd.3 Implement fitToSection in MapCanvas

## Description
Implement the core `fitToSection()` method in MapCanvas that zooms the map to show a specific section at ~80% of visible area, accounting for open side panels.

**Size:** M
**Files:** `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx`

## Approach

- Follow existing `fitToBounds()` pattern at `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:1130-1150`
- Watch `requestZoomToSection` from UIStore via useEffect
- Filter stations by `section_id` to get section geometry
- Use `getBounds()` from `src/utils/coordinates.ts:118` for bounds calculation
- Use `metersToMapCoords()` for coordinate transformation
- Calculate padding: read panel widths from UIStore/DOM, add 10% margin
- Call `map.stop()` before `map.fitBounds()` to cancel any running animation
- Handle edge cases:
  - Single station: use `map.easeTo()` with `point_zoom` from config
  - Empty section (0 stations): no-op, just clear request
- Respect `config.map.animation.enabled` and `duration` settings

## Key context

- MapLibre padding accumulation bug: call `map.setPadding({top:0,right:0,bottom:0,left:0})` before fitBounds
- Use `linear: true` in fitBounds options for easeTo behavior
- Panel widths available from UIStore: `sectionsPanelWidth`, `detailPanelWidth`
## Acceptance
- [ ] `fitToSection(sectionId)` method implemented in MapCanvas
- [ ] useEffect watches `requestZoomToSection` and calls `fitToSection`
- [ ] Stations filtered by section_id correctly
- [ ] Padding accounts for visible side panels + 10% margin
- [ ] `map.stop()` called before starting new animation
- [ ] Single-station sections center at `point_zoom` level
- [ ] Empty sections handled gracefully (no-op)
- [ ] Animation respects config.map.animation settings
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes

# fn-12-szd.4 Add double-click handler to SectionsPanel

## Description
Add double-click handler to section items in SectionsPanel that triggers zoom to section.

**Size:** S
**Files:** `src/components/SingleSystemView/SectionsPanel.tsx`

## Approach

- Add `onDoubleClick` handler to section list item at line 76
- Handler calls both `setSelection` (to select) and `triggerZoomToSection` (to zoom)
- Single-click continues to work as before (selection only)
- Use `event.detail === 2` check if needed to differentiate, but since both actions are additive (select + zoom), the natural browser behavior is acceptable

## Key context

- Existing pattern: `onClick={handleSectionClick}` sets selection
- Double-click fires after two single clicks (browser behavior)
- Both handlers can coexist since select + zoom is the desired double-click behavior
## Acceptance
- [ ] `onDoubleClick` handler added to section list items
- [ ] Double-click selects section AND triggers zoom to section
- [ ] Single-click behavior unchanged (selection only)
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes

# fn-12-szd.5 Add Ctrl+G keyboard shortcut

## Description
Add Ctrl+G keyboard shortcut to focus the currently selected section on the map.

**Size:** S
**Files:** `src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts`

## Approach

- Follow existing Ctrl+0 pattern at `src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:131-134`
- Add case for `g` key with Ctrl modifier
- Check if current selection is a section (`selection?.type === 'section'`)
- If section selected, call `triggerZoomToSection(selection.sectionId)`
- If no section selected, no-op (do nothing)

## Key context

- Keyboard shortcuts must not fire when user is typing in input/textarea
- Existing guards in useKeyboardShortcuts handle this
## Acceptance
- [ ] Ctrl+G handler added to useKeyboardShortcuts
- [ ] Zooms to selected section when section is selected
- [ ] No-op when no section is selected
- [ ] Does not interfere with text input (existing guards)
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes
